instruction: Candid medium shot of four martial artists posing together in front of a red brick wall. On the far left, a young girl in a red gi (R3) looks up smiling at the girl with braided hair (R4) next to her. Beside them, a boy with light brown hair (R2) and a blonde woman (R1) stand side-by-side, smiling at the camera. They stand in a line with arms draped over each other's shoulders in a friendly group embrace. The scene is captured with soft, even indoor lighting and natural colors.
